MotionCal magcal.h
==================

License:    none found
Copyright:  Paul Stoffregen (PJRC), presumed
Used in:    qtcalibrate
Source:     https://github.com/PaulStoffregen/MotionCal

Note: the MotionCal repository carries no license file, so this file is
distributed without a written license grant from its author. It is compiled
only into qtcalibrate; no other host program contains it.

quality.c was removed on 2026-10-10. Its four metrics are replaced by owned
arithmetic in host/libraries/sensoranalysis/magquality.h, and the sample
discard rule that depended on them by magretention.h. What remains of the gap
is this header, which declares the Freescale solver in magcal.c and matrix.c
-- those two are BSD-3-Clause and carry their own notice.
